events.text: Grapes for the 2026 harvest are pressed at the Old Barn press house.
Bottling for the 2026 vintage is contracted to Vinline Mobile Bottling.
The harvest manager for the 2026 harvest is Marta Silva.
Seasonal pickers for the 2026 harvest are paid 14 euros an hour.
Picking for the 2026 harvest is scheduled to start on 7 September 2026.
New oak barrels for the 2026 vintage are ordered from Tonnellerie Marchand.
The tasting room opens at 10am and pours its last tasting 30 minutes before the 6pm close.
Vineyard policy: no copper spray may be applied within 48 hours before forecast rain.
Must samples for the 2026 harvest are analysed by Clearwater Oenology Lab.
Tank 7 in the North Cellar holds the Pinot Noir from the Lower Terrace block.
Tank 7 in the South Cellar holds the Chardonnay from the Hilltop block.
Consultant winemaker Dr. Ines Albrecht's day rate is 600 euros.
Grapes for the rose trial are pressed at the Old Barn press house.
Bottling for the Hollowbrook Estate 2026 vintage is contracted to Vinline Mobile Bottling.
On 22 August 2026 a hailstorm stripped about a third of the leaves on the Hilltop block.
Pressing for the 2026 harvest moved to the shared press at Millbrook Cooperative.
We stopped using Vinline Mobile Bottling because their filler contaminated two pallets of the 2025 Sauvignon Blanc with cleaning solution.
Bottling for the 2026 vintage switched to Cork and Crown Bottlers.
Marta Silva retired, so the harvest manager is now Owen Pryce.
Correction: the harvest manager who replaced Marta Silva is Owen Price, not Owen Pryce.
Picking for the 2026 harvest was pushed back to 14 September 2026 because sugar levels were rising slowly after the hail.
The picker wage was raised to 16 euros an hour to match the rate offered by the neighbouring Saltmarsh vineyard.
Seasonal pickers for the 2026 harvest are now paid 16 euros an hour.
Dr. Ines Albrecht's day rate went up to 750 euros.
Pressing for the rose trial moved to the Lower Terrace pressing shed.
Pressing for the 2026 harvest moved to the Lower Terrace pressing shed.
New oak barrels for the 2026 vintage are now ordered from Oakhaven Cooperage.
Bottling for the 2026 vintage switched to Glassworth Bottling.
Tank 7 in the North Cellar now holds the Syrah from the Creek block.
Pressing for the 2026 harvest moved to the new press room in Winery Hall.
Picking for the 2026 harvest was brought forward to 11 September 2026 after a heatwave forecast.
The mobile press unit was brought in because the Winery Hall press room failed its electrical inspection in September.
Pressing for the 2026 harvest moved to a mobile press unit parked in the North Gate yard.
The picker wage for the 2026 harvest dropped to 15 euros an hour once a separate end-of-harvest bonus was introduced.
Owen Price is on paternity leave, so Lena Kovac is now the harvest manager.
The tasting room now opens at 11am and pours its last tasting 15 minutes before the 5pm close.
Bottling for the 2026 vintage switched to Ridgeway Bottling Services.
